title: Smart QS in Excel
intro: Store versions and review checks. Excel stays the editor.
empty: No workbooks. Upload one in the Smart QS document hub first.
openVersion: Open file version number (auto-filled when AegisQS metadata is available)
fallback: Excel on the web cannot export this workbook through Office.js. Use Excel’s download-a-copy action, then select that copy. Confirm it is this open workbook.
checkBasis: Run checks on the selected AegisQS workbook version. Cell navigation is enabled only when the open workbook is confirmed to match that version.
noChecks: No check results displayed. Choose Check this workbook; processing may still be running.
signinBasis: Sign in through your Smart QS backend. No authentication token is sent to the task pane.
signinFooter: For a real backend, sign in through its configured login page and return to this dialog.
saved: Version {version} saved. Excel cell values were not changed.
checksReadyCurrent: {count} issues found in this workbook. It matches the latest AegisQS version.
checksReadyCloudOnly: {count} issues found in the latest AegisQS version. Your open workbook is not confirmed as this version, so cloud-version navigation is unavailable.
checksPending: Version {version} is {status}. Check again in a few seconds.
statusUnknown: AegisQS could not determine the open workbook version.
statusUnverified: AegisQS could not verify which workbook version is currently open.
statusCurrent: This workbook matches the latest AegisQS version.
statusOutdated: A newer workbook version is available.
statusAhead: The open workbook is newer than the latest AegisQS version. Review the selected workbook.
statusMismatch: The open workbook version does not match the latest AegisQS version.
statusError: Load the current AegisQS version before checking version status.
failed: The action could not be completed. Review your connection and selected workbook, then try again.
confirmCopy: I confirm this downloaded copy matches the open workbook.
verifyVersion: Cell navigation is unavailable because the open workbook is not confirmed to match the checked AegisQS version.
loginError: Sign-in failed. Check your email and password and try again.
